description: This file defines the class FormatWithDate which implements the ValueFormatter interface. It provides a method to format DateTime objects into a 'Y-m-d' string.

classes.name: FormatWithDate
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects into a string representation of date in 'Y-m-d' format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the date in 'Y-m-d' format if the input is a DateTime instance, otherwise returns null.
